self_assessment: Added User.getIconBackgrounds(uid = 0) to src/user/data.js as a real method on the exported User object, returning a Promise of the avatar background colour list and passing it through a new filter:user.iconBackgrounds hook so plugins can extend it. It is defined inside the single module.exports = function (User) factory and nothing afterwards reassigns User or module.exports (src/user/index.js does const User = module.exports and only mutates it), so the method is reachable from other modules and tests exactly like the other public methods. The previously module-scoped colour array was removed in favour of the new accessor, modifyUserData now awaits it, and icon:bgColor is honoured when the user's stored value is one of the allowed colours (falling back to the existing username-derived index otherwise); icon:bgColor was added to fieldWhitelist so it can be requested. Verified at runtime by loading data.js and calling User.getIconBackgrounds - it is a function, resolves to a 14-element array of valid CSS hex colours, and works with or without a uid argument. NodeBB's own suite needs a live redis/mongo instance so it could not be run here.
